witness_description: Let G be the triangle on vertices {0,1,2}, with all three edges having weight 1. Let T have edges {(0,1),(0,2)}, and let e=(0,1). Then e lies on the cycle 0-1-2-0 in G and e belongs to the MST T, while T is the acyclic path 1-0-2.
refutation_explanation: T has total weight 2, equal to every spanning tree of G, so T is an MST. The cycle containing e in G uses edge (1,2), which is absent from T; consequently, membership of e in both the ambient cycle and T does not put the whole cycle in T.
search_space: Exhaustively swept all 64 simple undirected weighted graphs on the fixed vertex set {0,1,2}, where each present edge has weight in {1,2,3}, together with all 8 subsets of the three possible edges as candidate MSTs and all 3 possible distinguished edges: 64*8*3 = 1536 tuples, in fixed lexicographic order.
